name: Retouch4me
summary: AI retouching plugins for photographers (Photoshop-compatible, Mac/Windows), sold as perpetual licences per plugin, as full-suite subscriptions with retouch credits, or as cloud retouching in credit packs. Free to try first: two free plugins, three free apps and a demo on every paid plugin.
best_for: high-volume portrait, school and wedding photographers who already live in Photoshop and want repetitive retouching (skin, stray hairs, dust, teeth) automated — owning the plugins outright or renting the whole suite on credits, whichever their volume favours
skip_if: occasional editors — the two free plugins, the free applications and a $24 pack of 100 cloud retouches cover light use; or anyone unwilling to do the three-lane maths, because picking the wrong lane here easily doubles what the same workflow costs
honest_knock: Work out which lane you are in before you pay, because the three lanes price the same photo very differently. One plugin forever at $145 is honest value — but a working portrait stack means four plugins at $145-$179 each, $648 in total, while the Start subscription hands you the entire set for $169 a year with 2,400 retouches included. The catch cuts the other way too: own-forever versus keep-paying is the real decision, since the credits' 5-year rollover only holds 'while the subscription is active' — stop paying and the suite and the stockpile are gone. Low volume? Cloud retouching without a subscription is sold in packs, $24 for 100 retouches, and at $0.15 to $0.24 a photo it is the dearest lane per image, not the cheapest.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (read 2026-09-07 on retouch4.me/pricing, and re-read 8 September 2026 while signed in: the signed-in tariff page shows the same three yearly cards, no member-only rate and retouch4.me/products/retouch-plugins) Three ways to pay. (1) Perpetual plugin licences, one-time. The photo collection is fifteen plugins: $145 for Heal, Crop, Face Make, Portrait Volumes, Skin Tone, Skin Mask, Mattifier, White Teeth, Eyes Bundle, Stray Hairs, Fabric, Dust and Color Match; $179 for Dodge & Burn and Clean Backdrop. Outside that collection: Lab $145, Mask Anything $29, the Vectorscope panel $30, video plugins from $124 and 3D LUT Creator Pro from $99. A four-plugin portrait stack (Heal, Crop, Dodge & Burn, Clean Backdrop) is $648 at list. Time-boxed sales run alongside the list: on 7 Sep 2026 Heal showed $108.75 (25% off $145) under a 'Workflow Revamp' promotion putting a different plugin on 25% off each Tuesday of the month. (2) Subscriptions, which include the full plugin set: Start $169 a year, Pro $299, Business $759 — a 'limited offer' against list rates of $20/$35/$90 a month, restated on the cards as $14.08/$24.92/$63.25 a month. They carry 2,400/6,000/18,000 retouching credits and 108,000/300,000/1,200,000 culling credits a year, 20/40/100 GB of MyShot storage, unlimited AI colour correction with batch processing, and a 14-day money-back guarantee that holds while you have used up to 500 retouches. 1 retouch = 1 credit regardless of how many plugins run on the image, and unused credits roll over up to 5 years while the subscription stays active. (3) Credit packs without a subscription: $24 for 100 retouching credits (plus 9,000 culling credits), $59 for 300 (25,000) and $179 for 1,200 (100,000) — $0.24, $0.20 and $0.15 a retouch, each with unlimited AI colour correction for 30 days after purchase. Free: a trial pack of 20 cloud photo retouches on sign-up (no card, seen in the account on 8 September 2026), the Frequency Separation and Color Match Free plugins, the Apex, Photoshop Panel and Arams applications, a Try Demo on every paid plugin, and free cloud retouches for uploading RAWs to their RAW Bank. Re-read 26 September 2026: subscriptions, packs and plugin prices unchanged. New on the page: each subscription now also lists Generative credits (4,800, 12,000 and 43,200 a year on Start, Pro and Business), and a 'Generation Packs' tab sells them one-time at $20 for 2,000, $75 for 10,000 and $132 for 24,000 - while the Start card itself says generative features are 'coming soon in Apex v1'.

compare_with.name: Evoto
compare_with.why: the credit-based AI retouching desktop app — Evoto bundles everything in one interface paid per export credit, Retouch4me offers lifetime plugins, a credit subscription or pay-per-photo; high volume favours owning the plugins, low volume favours credits. Verify both current price lists yourself.

sessions.what: Online Retouch (retouch4.me/onlineretouch) on a partner test account holding 300 retouching credits, 10 culling credits and 10 colour credits; one JPEG uploaded, meter read before and after.
findings: One upload cost exactly one retouching credit: the counter went from 300 to 299. The charge is taken on upload, before you see the result, and it was taken for a non-portrait image (a UI screenshot) just the same.

That single credit ran eight plugins in one pass: Heal, Mattifier, Dodge & Burn, Portrait Volumes, Skin Tone, Eye Vessels, Eye Brilliance and White Teeth were all switched on by default; Fabric and Clean Backdrop off. So 1 retouch = 1 credit regardless of how many plugins run holds for the web tool.
The six sample photos on the page can be tried without spending a credit; the counter stayed at 300.
The account page offers a free trial pack of 20 cloud retouches without a card, which the public pricing page does not mention.
Not tested: Apex, Arams and the Photoshop Panel (desktop apps) and the culling and colour credits.
